summary: Phase 7 (TruthLemma two cases via reduction) implemented exactly per the F6 sketch, no design deviation. Added truth_lemma_allFuture/truth_lemma_allPast to Cslib/Logics/Temporal/Metalogic/Chronicle/TruthLemma.lean: each derives IHs for neg-phi and top from the single ih_phi via truth_lemma_imp + truth_lemma_bot (phi.imp bot = neg phi, bot.imp bot = top, both defeq through the abbrev chain Formula.neg/Formula.top -> PropositionalConnectives.neg/.top), assembles the compound neg(top U neg-phi) / neg(top S neg-phi) truth lemma via truth_lemma_untl_forward/backward or truth_lemma_snce_forward/backward, then bridges to the primitive GX/HX via Satisfies.sat_allFuture_iff_neg_someFuture_neg/sat_allPast_iff_neg_somePast_neg (semantic, Phase 2) and mcs_allFuture_iff/mcs_allPast_iff (MCS-level, Phase 5). Wired both as new arms into chronicle_truth_lemma's induction. Two mechanical (non-design) fixups: (1) (GX) ∈ limitF needed explicit parens -- unparenthesized GX ∈ limitF, the prefix-40 G/H notation greedily absorbed 'X ∈ limitF ...' as its own argument (Formula-vs-Prop type mismatch), matching the parenthesization already used at mcs_allFuture_iff's own statement; (2) sat_allFuture_iff_neg_someFuture_neg/sat_allPast_iff_neg_somePast_neg live inside the `Satisfies` namespace (declared via a separate `namespace Satisfies` block after `def Satisfies`, not dot-notation on the recursive def) and needed the `Satisfies.` qualifier, matching Metalogic/Soundness.lean:316-325's call convention. No new canonical-model/coherence lemma (D4 honored). No sorry, no vacuous definitions, no axioms beyond propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound (lean_verify clean on chronicle_truth_lemma, truth_lemma_allFuture, truth_lemma_allPast). lean_multi_attempt combinator search (Risk R3) was not needed in practice -- the F6 sketch's IH-derivation shape type-checked directly via abbrev defeq, so the predicted combinator ambiguity did not materialize. Scoped build `lake build Cslib.Logics.Temporal.Metalogic.Chronicle.TruthLemma` GREEN (941/941 jobs, only pre-existing unrelated unusedSimpArgs warnings in TemporalContent.lean). Plan file: Phase 7 heading [NOT STARTED] -> [COMPLETED], all 5 checklist items checked, Testing & Validation P7 row checked, Phase 7 result paragraph added documenting the two mechanical fixups.
